gen-bricolage-grotesque-fs-karma: A big x-height crowding its ascenders gives Bricolage Grotesque a stocky look. Karma, a text serif, takes the gentle reading.
gen-bricolage-grotesque-fs-paquito: Tall-bodied and tightly packed, Bricolage Grotesque takes the lead. Paquito follows with confident, approachable letters whose lowercase nearly reaches cap height, doing the talking while the heading announces.
gen-bricolage-grotesque-fs-ranade: Bricolage Grotesque keeps its strokes nearly uniform, while Ranade, a sans-serif body, shifts weight only slightly, like stretched rubber cord. Long stretches would drift by at a loose, unhurried pace.
gen-bricolage-grotesque-gf-lisu-bosa: A big x-height crowding its ascenders defines Bricolage Grotesque, while Lisu Bosa, a serif, pinches slightly where curves meet stems. Lisu Bosa's counters spill outward, so extended reading feels sturdy and large.
gen-bricolage-grotesque-roboto-slab: Roboto Slab is a slab-serif whose middle zone dominates each line, with open throats on a, c, e, and s. Roboto Slab supplies the structure beneath Bricolage Grotesque, whose big open c keeps the headings clean.
gen-bungee-fs-rowan: Bungee keeps its letters apart, never touching, with unmodulated lines and a punched-stencil pinhole mouth. And Rowan opens every curve generously, a friendly body built for brief stretches of reading.
gen-bungee-gf-hepta-slab: Playful Bungee keeps every letter closed and separate. Hepta Slab, a serif of open counters and no thick-thin shifts, is worth setting at a generous size so those counters can breathe.
gen-bungee-inline-fs-rowan: Retro letters spaced like beads on a long cord: that's Bungee Inline. Decoration is where Bungee Inline excels; Rowan, with a modest thick-thin difference, takes the text, just not lengthy paragraphs.
gen-bungee-inline-gf-bhutuka-expanded-on: Decorative and retro, Bungee Inline spaces its glyphs like beads. Bungee Inline makes the showy statement, while BhuTuka Expanded One, a text serif, slows reading to a leisurely walk with fat crossbars.
gen-butcherman-fs-public-sans: Public Sans is trustworthy, with a hefty lowercase. Butcherman's dark, raw letters stay apart with tiny slot-like apertures, which makes Public Sans's broad counters feel like fresh air.
